---
title: "Getting Started"
---

tether ties heterogeneous data objects -- files and object-store prefixes,
Icechunk repositories, Neon Postgres databases, Iceberg / Delta / DuckLake
tables, Lance datasets, lakeFS repositories, Dolt databases, git/jj
repositories -- to the commits of an existing git or jj repository. A commit
records every object's state and, where the system supports it, creates a
durable native reference (a tag, a branch at an LSN) so that state can be read
back and branched from later.

## Install

```bash
pip install tether-vcs[cli]                 # core + CLI
pip install tether-vcs[cli,icechunk,neon]   # add the backends you use
pip install tether-vcs[all]                 # everything
```

The distribution is `tether-vcs` (PyPI reserves the bare name); the package you
import and the command you run are both `tether`.

Extras per backend: `objectstore` (S3/GCS/Azure for `file`; `s3`, `gcs`, `azure`
are aliases), `icechunk`, `neon`, `iceberg`, `delta`, `lance`, `lakefs`,
`ducklake`, `dolt`. `git` and/or `jj` must be on `PATH`: tether stores its
history inside your repository rather than keeping its own.

## A dataset in five commands

Run these inside any git or jj repository (a new one is fine):

```bash
tether init
tether add zarr/imaging --kind icechunk s3://bucket/imaging.icechunk --branch main
tether add db/metrics   --kind neon --project-id prj-123 --database neondb --role runner
tether add raw/plate1   --kind file s3://bucket/raw/plate1/
tether status
```

```
dataset 0f2e9c7a11b3
       new  db/metrics  [neon/forkable]
       new  raw/plate1  [file/observed] unrecoverable
       new  zarr/imaging  [icechunk/forkable]
```

`status` fanned out to all three systems concurrently, fingerprinted each one
(a Neon LSN, an Icechunk snapshot id, an etag digest over the prefix), and
classified them. Nothing has been recorded yet; `init` and `add` only wrote
small TOML manifests under `.tether/`.

```bash
tether commit -m "Baseline imaging + metrics"
```

```
  pinned zarr/imaging -> tether.6674305d5e1f
  pinned db/metrics -> tether.a91f0e2b77c3
  recorded raw/plate1 (not recoverable)
committed 8d5719841a09
```

That one command created an Icechunk tag and a protected Neon branch (the
*pins*), wrote the states into the manifests, and made a jj/git commit of those
manifests. The commit id is the handle for this exact combination of states,
forever.

## Layout

```
<dataset-root>/
  tether.toml                 # committed config
  .tether/
    .gitignore                # ignores workspace.toml
    objects/<key>.toml        # committed, one per object: kind, locator, policy, state, pin
    listings/<hash>.jsonl     # committed per-file listings for directory/prefix states
    workspace.toml            # untracked: workspace id, working refs, cached snapshot
```

Everything committed is small, text, and reviewable in `jj diff` / `git diff`.
